captions.detailed: A Y-shaped mechanical tree model consisting of a dark grey vertical trunk mounted on a rectangular base, capped with a horizontal cross-hub. Two independent, angled green branch arms extend outwards from cylindrical joint hubs on either side. Each branch is tipped with a small cylindrical end cap, and both branches can rotate independently around their respective horizontal joint axes.
captions.instruction: Create a Y-shaped mechanical tree with two independent rotary branches. The model should feature a dark grey rectangular base and vertical trunk, a horizontal cross-hub, and two green angled branches connected via cylindrical revolute joints that allow independent rotation.
captions.factory: Construct a base and vertical trunk using box primitives. Add a horizontal cylinder cross-hub at the top of the trunk to serve as the parent link. Create two symmetric branch parts, each consisting of a rectangular arm, a cylindrical joint hub, and a small cylindrical tip. Define revolute joints on each side of the cross-hub, aligned along the horizontal Y-axis, to connect the left and right branch parts.
